name: Azure ML Deployment Blue-Green Strategy
summary: Implement a blue-green deployment strategy for Azure Machine Learning models to minimize downtime and deployment risks.
description: The Azure Machine Learning Deployment Blue-Green Strategy project aims to establish a robust deployment framework that minimizes downtime and mitigates deployment risks associated with machine learning models. This approach involves creating two identical environments, known as 'blue' and 'green'. The blue environment represents the current production version, while the green environment is where the new version of the model will be deployed. By switching traffic between these environments, we can ensure seamless updates and rollbacks if necessary. The project will include setting up the Azure infrastructure, configuring CI/CD pipelines, and implementing monitoring tools to track performance and errors. This strategy not only enhances the reliability of deployments but also allows for thorough testing of new features in a live environment without affecting the end-users. The final deliverables will provide a comprehensive guide and implementation plan for maintaining this deployment strategy effectively.
